sentences.en: I like handball; as for my friend, he prefers volleyball.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢手球，而我的朋友则更喜欢排球。

sentences.en: She was hired to play in her nation's handball team.
sentences.zh: 她被聘请代表国家手球队参赛。

sentences.en: A group of young men are playing handball in the playground.
sentences.zh: 一群年轻人正在操场上打手球。
